Participants, procedure and measures
156 Berkeley students answered questions about 15 quantities. The calibration group (53) made unanchored estimates. For the other 103, the 15th or 85th calibration percentile supplied the anchor for each question. People first compared the quantity with the anchor, then estimated it and rated confidence.

result
What the paper reports
scope-01
result
Result
The mean question-level anchoring index was 0.49. Median transformed estimates were at the 76th calibration percentile for high anchors and 36th for low anchors.
